changelog: PERF: Massive cold-start speedup — Canada APK now ships with TMDB metadata, sports schedules, themes pack, and 397 hero/poster images baked in. Discovery rails, Sports tab, Genres, and Collections all paint instantly from local assets instead of waiting on 50+ outbound TMDB/sports HTTP calls. Same architecture that ran clean on the dev channel for several hours.

FIX: Re-wired HushBundleMapper into Coil's ImageLoader — was previously defined but never registered, which silently bypassed the existing 44-entry streaming logo + decade backdrop bundle on every flavor. Now active.
NOTE: APK size grew 25 MB → ~56 MB to accommodate the baked images. One-time download hit; subsequent app launches are faster than ever.
INHERITED v1.44.127: Auto cache-clear on launch.
INHERITED v1.44.125: Fire Stick black-screen-on-play fix (SurfaceView for Lite mode).
INHERITED v1.44.124: Migration moved off main thread.
INHERITED v1.44.123: Fresh-install Fire Stick crash loop fix + 9 granular boot marks.
INHERITED v1.44.122: Removed AMAZON from premium-brand bypass; one-shot Pro→Lite migration.
